What is The Haunted Veil?

It is a treasure hunt set in a haunted night. Your team gets a clue, cracks it, and moves to the next stage before the lanterns burn out.

Each level mixes riddles, objects, and tech puzzles. Stay sharp, work together, and be the first to reach the final stage.

  • 4haunted levels

The four levels

Each level unlocks the next. Tap a level to see what waits inside.

  1. Crack the opening riddle to unlock the path and receive your first lantern.

  2. A ghost is hiding inside the machine. Solve the tech puzzle to trace it.

  3. Memorize scattered objects under intense time pressure. One wrong recall ends your hunt!

  4. The final riddle. Reach the treasure before every other team does.
